note: Passive registry. Fields are ids, files, titles and human-readable triggers only. The skeleton decides WHEN to read a section; nothing here does.

sections.title: Path walk protocol
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor walk - traversing a path actor by actor, with or without a stressor applied

sections.title: Stressor generation method
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor generate, or extending an existing stressor set with a new class

sections.title: Impact matrix construction and reading
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor analyze or /restack-stressor vulnerabilities - building the matrix, scoring it, or interpreting what it shows

sections.title: Residual identification and leverage
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor residues - proposing residuals and ranking them by leverage

sections.title: Challenge by removal (ablation)
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor ablate - finding a candidate to challenge, or scoring the removal of an adopted residual, the actors it created and what was built on it

sections.title: Ablation report template
sections.trigger: writing docs/stressor-analysis/ablation-<date>-<slug>.md at the end of /restack-stressor ablate

sections.title: Workshop facilitation
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor workshop - facilitating the analysis with a group rather than a single architect

sections.title: Outside opinion - cross-model second read
sections.trigger: running /restack-stressor generate or residues and an outside opinion would help - generating the complement of your stressor list, or checking a mechanism diagnosis against a model that has not seen your reasoning
